study: WCA dimer: does earlier Fisher-Rao activation (and early stopping) improve validated histogram-ABF convergence?

physics.integrator: float64 Euler-Maruyama with the accepted force clips and soft RC wall (wca_numba)

engine_cfg_rule: validated_cfg(fr_start_t): engine_cfg_template with fr_start_steps = round(fr_start_t / dt); fr_stop_steps (run_ladder_point kwarg) = round(fr_stop_t / dt) or None
init: wca_numba.lattice_init(seed, 256) (the torch engine's lattice init); Langevin noise: default_noise_seed(seed, 256), SeedSequence child 0 (identical in every arm); FR stream of an arm: child 1 + fr_stream_id

arms.name: fr_start40
arms.role: validated delayed-FR schedule (stream 0 = the Phase-V FR arm's stream)

arm_inclusion_decision.basis: validated Phase-V wall times: 0.85 h (ABF) / 0.88 h (per FR arm) per 256 x 1.92e6 run on this host -> 7 x 16 x 0.88 = 98.6 core-h <= 200 core-h cap; decided before any production run

seed_rationale: fresh consecutive block; not 5100-5115 (Phase-V), not 3300-3307 (dt 0.002 start ladder); no WCA result or doc uses 5600-5615 (checked 2026-10-20)

save_grid.rule: every 0.5 t.u. on [0, 20], every 1 t.u. on (20, 80], every 5 t.u. on (80, 240]

reference.label: exact Gibbs (Metropolis MC, 64 chains): F_density; mean force = MC bin means
reference.rule: rescore_wca_history.mc_reference(); the analysis asserts the recomputed reference equals this file

metrics.e_F: wca_numba.score_ladder_result(...)['l2_f_t'] with the frozen reference (aligned L2 on [-0.1, 1.1])
metrics.e_Fp: score_ladder_result(...)['l2_fp_t'] (histogram_fp_error_np: own e_F' of the histogram arms)
metrics.e_xi_full: ||p - 1/1.4||_L2 on [-0.2, 1.2] from z_hist (160 bins; out-of-range replicas clamped into the edge bins by the engine)
metrics.e_xi_interior: the same on the 158 interior bins only, renormalised (u = 1/(1.4 - 2 * 0.00875)); labelled diagnostic

sensitivity_windows.after_reset_20_80: (20, 80]: trapezoid from t = 21 to 80, excluding the t = 20 reset save (production estimator holding one step of deposits)

metrics.integral: trapezoid of e_F over the saves with a <= t <= b

time_to_accuracy.definition: sustained: first save t with e_F <= eps at that and every later save; censored (> T) if e_F(240) > eps
time_to_accuracy.chosen_from: validated Phase-V ABF-only arm (seeds 5100-5115, no FR curve read): each eps is reached by ABF in >= 14/16 seeds; medians 27.5, 30, 40, 50, 137.5 t.u.
time_to_accuracy.paired: per seed S = min(tau_ABF, T) / min(tau_FR, T); censoring counts reported; both-censored seeds are ties

statistics.G: I_arm / I_base - 1 per seed (same for final errors)
statistics.ci: percentile bootstrap of the median, 10000 resamples, numpy default_rng(20261020)
statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni over the two primary contrasts: a primary is SUPPORTED if its 97.5 % bootstrap CI (1.25 / 98.75 percentiles) lies entirely below 0, CONTRADICTED if entirely above 0, otherwise UNRESOLVED; ordinary 95 % CIs reported alongside
secondary: every FR arm vs abf on I_F[20,80], I_F[0,240], e_F(240) (and all other windows, descriptive)
fr_start0_stop20 vs abf; fr_start0_stop40 vs abf
e_F'(240), marginal metrics, genealogy, time to accuracy
statistics.early_convergence_benefit: an FR arm vs abf: SUPPORTED if the 95 % CI of G on I_F[20,80] lies entirely below 0
statistics.safe_early_stopping: a stop arm: early_convergence_benefit SUPPORTED and final-error non-inferiority vs abf established: 95 % CI upper bound of G on e_F(240) < +5 %; DEGRADED if the CI lower bound > +5 %; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE
statistics.descriptive_labels: secondary contrasts: CI < 0 'FR better', CI > 0 'FR worse', otherwise 'not resolved'; no post-hoc selection of a best schedule

exclusions.rule: no seed is excluded for its outcome; a run that crashes or produces a non-finite state is rerun once (the engine is deterministic, so a reproducible failure is REPORTED as a failure); statistics then use the seeds with complete data for the arms compared, and the failure is listed in the validation report
exclusions.tuning: no physical, estimator, FR, seed, window or tolerance setting is changed after any production result is read
